title: Local Refinement Around Round 1 Optimum with ±6nm Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: The round 1 optimum (0.846 score, 14 layers) represents a favorable basin in the design space; tight local refinement (±6nm) with gradient acceleration will recover or exceed that performance by fine-tuning phase-matching without escaping the basin.
design_principle: Constrained local optimization preserves the successful global structure from round 1 while allowing fine adjustment of optical thickness for dual-band performance. Gradient-based optimizer (L-BFGS) dampens coarse oscillations observed between intermediate rounds.
proposed_topology: exactly 14 finite layers from the incident side: HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2
manufacturing_considerations: ±6nm tolerance represents tight but achievable deposition control for space-qualified coatings
HfO2 outermost layer for environmental durability
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
Local gradient-based optimization converges faster than global search when near optimum
Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflection bands
expected_advantages: Tight bounds reduce risk of escaping good basin
Gradient acceleration dampens oscillations from prior rounds
known_risks: May be trapped in local optimum if round 1 was not global best
±6nm may be too restrictive if round 1 thicknesses were suboptimal
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 14-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2 / HfO2 / SiO2. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Optimize a 14-layer HfO2/SiO2 alternating stack on fused silica substrate with air incident medium. Initialize thicknesses from round 1 best candidate: [50.69, 81.96, 44.76, 74.71, 61.68, 82.14, 65.10, 121.47, 70.87, 91.78, 79.48, 119.16, 63.56, 64.70] nm. Apply ±6nm absolute bounds on each layer thickness. Use gradient-based optimizer (L-BFGS or BFGS variant) with learning rate 0.025. Evaluate transmittance at 1530-1565nm band and reflectance at 400-700nm band at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Total layers fixed at 14. Material sequence: HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers.
revision_reason: Round 1 achieved best score (0.846); subsequent rounds with different bounds/layer counts regressed to 0.481. Feedback directive explicitly recommends tight local refinement around round 1 optimum with ±6nm bounds and gradient-accelerated optimizer to dampen coarse oscillations.
